name: Kansspelautoriteit
coverage: Full Kansspelwijzer provider feed, 527 published permission rows across the online, land-based and lottery categories. Licence numbers, scopes, validity dates and holder names come directly from the register. Contact details are excluded. The enforcement collection is a reviewed selection of 20 named proceedings, including dated stages of objections and court review. It is not a complete incident register and cannot support a national enforcement rate. Contingent payments under compliance orders are distinct from fines.

actions.date_basis: Decision date recorded in the Council of State judgment
actions.title: Council of State orders a new objection decision
actions.summary: The court set aside the January 2022 objection decision and ordered KSA to make a fresh decision within 26 weeks. The judgment does not establish a final revocation or the start date of the proceeding.

actions.date_basis: Decision date recorded in the Council of State judgment
actions.title: Council of State orders a new objection decision
actions.summary: The court set aside the January 2022 objection decision and ordered KSA to make a fresh decision within 26 weeks. The judgment does not establish a final revocation or the start date of the proceeding.

actions.title: Duty-of-care fine for the ComeOn operator
actions.status: Objection decision published; further appeal available as reported
actions.summary: The original fine was €750,000. KSA records an October 2026 objection decision and the availability of court review.

actions.title: Council of State fixed the fine at €497,500
actions.summary: In the Betchan proceeding the Council of State replaced the original €500,000 fine with €497,500. Its ruling links to the regulator’s earlier decision.

actions.title: Anti-money-laundering direction
actions.summary: KSA published its direction under the Dutch anti-money-laundering statute after the direction became irrevocable.

actions.title: Anti-money-laundering direction
actions.summary: KSA published a direction under the Wwft with the underlying decision dated 28 October 2025.

actions.title: Duty-of-care fine
actions.status: Court appeal against decision on objection recorded
actions.summary: KSA imposed €4 million for duty-of-care failures. The dossier records a court appeal after its March 2026 objection decision.

actions.title: Order concerning prohibited sports betting markets
actions.summary: KSA ordered the operator to stop offering bets on prohibited events. Any contingent payment under the order is not reported as a paid fine.

actions.title: Duty-of-care fine concerning young adult players
actions.summary: KSA imposed €2.65 million. Its dossier says the objection was rejected and that the operator brought a court appeal.

actions.title: District court rejected the appeal against the €900,000 fine
actions.summary: The district court rejected the appeal. KSA reports that Fairload challenged the judgment on higher appeal.

actions.title: Admitting players listed in the Cruks self-exclusion register
actions.summary: KSA fined the operator €400,000 after it admitted excluded players. The dossier says Optdeck accepted the sanction.

actions.title: Fine reduced after reassessment of revenue figures
actions.status: Reduced on objection; court appeal recorded
actions.summary: KSA reported that the violation finding stood and the amount fell to €975,000. Its dossier records a court appeal against the objection decision.

actions.title: District court left €12.64 million fine in force
actions.status: District court ruling; subsequent appellate status unverified
actions.summary: In a separate unlicensed-offering proceeding KSA reports that the appeal succeeded on a point and that the €12,640,000 fine remained in force at this stage.

actions.title: Order to stop offering unlicensed online games
actions.status: Final after objection; no court appeal
actions.summary: KSA directed the operator of lala.bet to stop its offering. The listed weekly and maximum sums were contingent on noncompliance, not a lump-sum fine.

actions.title: Anti-money-laundering direction became irrevocable
actions.summary: KSA reports that the 2019 Wwft direction became irrevocable following the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal judgment.

actions.date_basis: Decision date in the attached regulator order
actions.title: Anti-money-laundering fine
actions.summary: KSA imposed a €3 million anti-money-laundering fine. The dossier published on 9 July 2024 says the operator did not object and the decision is final.

actions.title: Original fine for unlicensed online gambling
actions.summary: KSA originally imposed €9,874,000. Its later objection decision reduced the amount to €975,000.

actions.title: District court preserved legal effects of the fine
actions.status: Court ruling; further appellate status unverified
actions.summary: The court set aside the reasoning on the amount while expressly maintaining the decision’s legal effects. The original and court stages share one case ID.

actions.title: Court left the unlicensed-offering fine in place
actions.status: Final; KSA records no higher appeal
actions.summary: The court accepted the appeal on a point but left the €400,000 fine intact. KSA records that no higher appeal followed.

actions.title: Court left the unlicensed-offering fine in place
actions.status: Final; KSA records no higher appeal
actions.summary: KSA reports that the court left this operator’s €350,000 fine intact and that the decision became irrevocable.

actions.date_basis: Decision date recorded in the Council of State judgment
actions.title: Slot-machine operating licence revoked
actions.summary: The Council of State records that KSA revoked the slot-machine operating licence on this date. On 25 November 2026 it ordered KSA to decide the objection again.

actions.date_basis: Decision date recorded in the Council of State judgment
actions.title: Slot-machine operating licence revoked
actions.summary: The Council of State records that KSA revoked the slot-machine operating licence on this date. On 25 November 2026 it ordered KSA to decide the objection again.

actions.title: Fine for unlicensed online offering
actions.status: Final; no court appeal against objection decision
actions.summary: KSA imposed €300,000 in the williamhill.com case. The dossier states no appeal was filed against the decision on objection.

actions.title: Fine for offering online games without a Dutch permit
actions.status: Original decision; subsequently reviewed by court
actions.summary: KSA listed a €312,500 fine for the mrgreen.com offering and recorded an objection. The 2022 judgment below is part of this proceeding.

actions.title: Advertising to minors: order backed by contingent payments
actions.summary: The regulator ordered the operator to stop the advertising. KSA records no further infringement in its compliance check and links the 2022 lifting decision. No cash fine is attributed.
